papers.title: Conflicts and coalitions among selfish toxin-antidote elements shape the evolution of hyperdivergent haplotypes
papers.translated_title: 自私的毒素-解毒剂元件之间的冲突与联盟塑造了高度分化单倍型的演化
papers.author: Koreshova, A.
papers.summary: Genetic conflict drives evolutionary innovation, yet most research has focused on arms races between selfish elements and their hosts. A second layer-competition among selfish elements-remains largely unexplored. Here, we uncover such a conflict between two antagonistic toxin-antidote elements (TAs), loki-1/sgyn-1 and thor-1/sif-1, in Caenorhabditis tropicalis. Each toxin, LOKI-1 or THOR-1, selectively kills progeny homozygous for the opposing haplotype, favoring heterozygotes. Their antidotes, SGYN-1 and SIF-1, evolved from F-box proteins, although SIF-1 subsequently lost its F-box domain. We solved the crystal structure of the THOR-1-SIF-1 complex and used in vivo mutagenesis to validate the binding interface, supporting direct toxin neutralization independently of F-box-mediated degradation. A survey of 676 wild isolates revealed two contrasting evolutionary outcomes of antagonizing TAs: independently evolved loki-1/sgyn-1 and thor-1/sif-1 remain confined to alternative hyperdivergent haplotypes, whereas other homologous TAs can recombine to form composite haplotypes. Altogether, our findings establish competition among selfish elements as a distinct form of genetic conflict, and support models in which antagonistic TAs act as barriers that restrict gene flow between neighboring populations.
papers.translated_summary: 遗传冲突驱动演化创新，然而大多数研究都集中在自私元件与其宿主之间的军备竞赛上。第二层冲突——自私元件之间的竞争——在很大程度上仍未被探索。在此，我们揭示了热带秀丽隐杆线虫中两个拮抗性毒素-解毒剂元件（TAs）之间的这种冲突，即loki-1/sgyn-1与thor-1/sif-1。每种毒素LOKI-1或THOR-1都会选择性地杀死对相反单倍型纯合的后代，从而有利于杂合子。它们的解毒剂SGYN-1和SIF-1从F-box蛋白演化而来，尽管SIF-1随后失去了其F-box结构域。我们解析了THOR-1-SIF-1复合物的晶体结构，并通过体内诱变验证了结合界面，支持不依赖F-box介导降解的直接毒素中和作用。对676个野生分离株的调查揭示了拮抗性TAs的两种截然不同的演化结果：独立演化的loki-1/sgyn-1和thor-1/sif-1仍局限于替代性高度分化的单倍型，而其他同源TAs可以重组形成复合单倍型。总之，我们的发现确立了自私元件之间的竞争作为一种独特的遗传冲突形式，并支持了拮抗性TAs作为限制邻近种群之间基因流动的屏障的模型。

papers.title: A foldable respiratory siphon enables near-surface locomotion through asymmetric rowing in Helophilus larvae
papers.translated_title: 一种可折叠的呼吸虹吸管使Helophilus幼虫能够通过不对称划动实现近表面运动
papers.author: Matsunaga, T.
papers.summary: Specialized animal structures often perform multiple functions, yet how their structural adaptations support distinct behaviors remains poorly understood. Eristaline hoverfly larvae, commonly known as rat-tailed maggots, possess exceptionally elongated and extensible posterior respiratory siphons that allow them to breathe while submerged. Here, we investigated the structural basis of siphon extension and its potential locomotor function in Helophilus virgatus larvae. Fluorescence labeling showed that siphon elongation involves the unfolding of previously concealed structures, while phalloidin staining revealed an extensive array of transversely oriented muscle fibers within the siphon. Behavioral observations further revealed a previously undescribed mode of horizontal locomotion just beneath the air water interface, involving asymmetric rowing movements of the posterior siphon. Kinematic analyses showed that most forward body displacements occurred during the backward stroke, which was associated with increased siphon straightness, whereas the forward stroke produced little net forward displacement. These findings reveal structural features underlying siphon extensibility and demonstrate that a specialized respiratory organ also contributes to locomotion, highlighting the multifunctionality of specialized body structures in aquatic environments.
papers.translated_summary: 特化的动物结构常具有多种功能，然而其结构适应如何支持不同行为仍知之甚少。Eristaline食蚜蝇幼虫，俗称鼠尾蛆，具有异常延长且可伸展的后部呼吸虹吸管，使其能够在浸没状态下呼吸。本文研究了Helophilus virgatus幼虫虹吸管伸展的结构基础及其潜在的运动功能。荧光标记显示，虹吸管的伸长涉及先前隐藏结构的展开，而鬼笔环肽染色则揭示了虹吸管内广泛分布的横向肌纤维阵列。行为观察进一步揭示了一种此前未被描述的水气界面正下方水平运动模式，涉及后部虹吸管的不对称划桨运动。运动学分析表明，大多数身体向前位移发生在后划阶段，该阶段与虹吸管直线度增加相关，而前划阶段产生的净向前位移很小。这些发现揭示了虹吸管可伸展性的结构特征，并证明特化的呼吸器官也有助于运动，突显了水生环境中特化身体结构的多功能性。

papers.title: Curated neurodegeneration axis signals are sensitive to cell composition and analytic choices: an adversarial re-analysis of a transcriptomic scoring pipeline
papers.translated_title: 精选的神经退行性轴信号对细胞组成和分析选择敏感：对转录组评分流程的对抗性再分析
papers.author: Ghosh, N.
papers.summary: Background: Curated gene-set ("axis") scores are widely used to summarise disease biology in postmortem brain transcriptomes. In bulk tissue such scores can also change with cell-type composition, with broad transcriptome shifts in diseased tissue, or with analysis choices made after the results were seen. We tested these explanations on our own published pipeline, NeuroFate, whose preprint reported an Alzheimer's disease (AD) "neuronal vulnerability" axis and a Parkinson's disease (PD) "divergent" synuclein-mitochondrial axis. Results: A code audit found that the AD discovery axis averaged Sst, Pvalb and Lamp5 interneuron cell-type proportions together with its gene-expression features; that 90 endpoint x axis tests were run before the endpoints were locked; that axes were defined from the cohorts later cited as discovery evidence; and that the PD-divergent label came from an axis-specific rule defined after the result. Their contribution to the AD association could not be quantified because the donor-level data were not archived. In GSE7621 (16 PD, 9 controls) the synuclein-mitochondrial association reproduced (exact p = 0.0011) but depended on the scoring method (exact p from 0.001 to 0.057; with per-gene standardisation no axis reached Benjamini-Hochberg significance), lay at the 2.4th percentile of 10,000 expression-matched random probe sets (two-sided p = 0.06), and was attenuated by 76% (95% interval 26% to >100%) after adjustment for a dopaminergic-marker expression proxy (PD coefficient -1.13 to -0.27 SD). A small laser-captured cohort (GSE20141; 10 PD, 8 controls) was inconclusive: no axis reached p < 0.05, and the synuclein-mitochondrial effect had the same sign. In 1,000 simulated cohorts, a naive test called a purely composition-driven gene set significant in 82% of cohorts, whereas the proposed battery classified it as composition-independent in 5% while recovering a planted within-cell effect in 98% (moderate effect) and 50% (weak effect) of cohorts. Conclusions: The original axis associations do not establish composition-independent disease programs; their interpretation is sensitive to feature construction, scoring and adjustment for cell composition. Curated axis scores in bulk brain tissue should be reported with competitive null distributions, composition adjustment, exact small-sample inference, and endpoints and scoring fixed before analysis. We provide code for these checks.
papers.translated_summary: 背景： curated gene-set（“轴”）评分被广泛用于概括死后脑转录组中的疾病生物学特征。在 bulk 组织中，此类评分也可能随细胞类型组成、疾病组织中广泛的转录组变化，或结果出现后所做的分析选择而改变。我们在自己已发表的流程 NeuroFate 上检验了这些解释，该流程的预印本报告了一个阿尔茨海默病（AD）“神经元脆弱性”轴和一个帕金森病（PD）“分歧性”突触核蛋白-线粒体轴。结果： 代码审计发现，AD 发现轴将其基因表达特征与 Sst、Pvalb 和 Lamp5 中间神经元细胞类型比例一起平均；在终点锁定之前运行了 90 个终点×轴检验；轴是从后来被引用为发现证据的队列中定义的；PD-分歧标签来自结果之后定义的轴特异性规则。它们对 AD 关联的贡献无法量化，因为供体水平数据未归档。在 GSE7621（16 例 PD，9 例对照）中，突触核蛋白-线粒体关联得到重现（精确 p = 0.0011），但依赖于评分方法（精确 p 从 0.001 到 0.057；采用逐基因标准化后，没有任何轴达到 Benjamini-Hochberg 显著性），位于 10,000 个表达匹配随机探针集的第 2.4 百分位（双侧 p = 0.06），并且在调整多巴胺能标志物表达代理后衰减 76%（95% 区间 26% 至 >100%）（PD 系数 -1.13 至 -0.27 SD）。一个小型激光捕获队列（GSE20141；10 例 PD，8 例对照）结果不确定：没有轴达到 p < 0.05，且突触核蛋白-线粒体效应具有相同符号。在 1,000 个模拟队列中，朴素检验在 82% 的队列中将纯组成驱动的基因集称为显著，而所提出的检验组在 5% 中将其分类为组成独立，同时在 98%（中等效应）和 50%（弱效应）的队列中恢复了植入的细胞内效应。结论： 原始轴关联不能确立组成独立的疾病程序；其解释对特征构建、评分和细胞组成调整敏感。bulk 脑组织中的 curated 轴评分应报告竞争性零分布、组成调整、精确小样本推断，并在分析前固定终点和评分。我们提供了这些检查的代码。

papers.title: Building computational benchmarks: an Omnibenchmark reimplementation of a single-cell preprocessing pipeline evaluation
papers.translated_title: 构建计算基准：单细胞预处理流程评估的Omnibenchmark重实现
papers.author: Choudhury, A.
papers.summary: Background: In the past few years, we have seen a veritable surge in single-cell (e.g., RNA-sequencing) techniques and datasets, enabling increasingly detailed characterization of cellular heterogeneity across tissues and conditions. This surge in single-cell techniques has been complemented by a large number of analysis frameworks and pipelines, and a large parameter space and researcher degrees of freedom to use them. Many neutral benchmarks have been presented for various computational tasks, but most make design decisions that render them incompatible with each other, e.g., through the use of different datasets, metrics, or parameter sets. Results: We showcase Omnibenchmark, a recently developed framework to build reproducible, extensible, and standardized method comparisons for an arms-length benchmark that evaluates five single-cell RNA sequencing pipelines, spanning filtering, normalization, dimensionality reduction, and clustering, on three datasets. The framework facilitates the broad investigation of pipelines used in single-cell data analysis while highlighting how the process of building benchmarks can be streamlined and unified. This standardization enables benchmarks to be extended in several directions, including broader parameter sweeps, comparisons across software versions and architectures, isolation of pipeline steps, and integration of additional pipelines, datasets, and metrics. As an example, our harmonization of pipelines highlighted that tools implement the (clustering) resolution parameter differently. Conclusions: Omnibenchmark provides a reproducible, extensible, and standardized approach for benchmarking. By unifying the process of benchmark construction, it can facilitate more consistent method comparisons and provides a foundation for broader, more flexible, and more sustainable benchmarking efforts.
papers.translated_summary: 背景：过去几年中，单细胞（例如RNA测序）技术和数据集出现了名副其实的激增，使得跨组织和条件下的细胞异质性表征日益精细。单细胞技术的激增伴随着大量分析框架和流程，以及使用它们的大量参数空间和研究者自由度。许多中性基准已被提出用于各种计算任务，但大多数在设计决策上彼此不兼容，例如通过使用不同的数据集、指标或参数集。结果：我们展示了Omnibenchmark，这是一个最近开发的框架，用于构建可重复、可扩展和标准化的方法比较，作为一个独立基准，在三个数据集上评估五个单细胞RNA测序流程，涵盖过滤、归一化、降维和聚类。该框架促进了对单细胞数据分析中所用流程的广泛研究，同时突出了如何简化和统一基准构建过程。这种标准化使基准能够在多个方向上扩展，包括更广泛的参数扫描、跨软件版本和架构的比较、流程步骤的隔离，以及额外流程、数据集和指标的整合。作为一个例子，我们对流程的协调突出表明，工具对（聚类）分辨率参数的实现方式不同。结论：Omnibenchmark提供了一种可重复、可扩展和标准化的基准测试方法。通过统一基准构建过程，它可以促进更一致的方法比较，并为更广泛、更灵活和更可持续的基准测试工作提供基础。

papers.title: The insect brain is specified by a conserved transcriptional program distinct from the segmental CNS
papers.translated_title: 昆虫大脑由一种与分节中枢神经系统不同的保守转录程序所指定
papers.author: Cabanas, N.
papers.summary: The brain is the central processing center that integrates information to guide animal behavior, while the posterior CNS performs less central functions. To what degree this functional distinction is reflected in divergence of the genetic regulation remains unexplored, as well as the hypothesis of a distinct evolutionary origin of brain and trunk CNS. In insects, neuroblast biology is similar across the CNS, but the presence of brain-specific neuroblast types and differences in the gene sets involved in their spatial and temporal specification indicate divergence. However, a comprehensive and unbiased comparison of the regulatory code of brain versus trunk neuroblasts has been lacking. Here, we reveal the transcription factors expressed in insect embryonic neuroblasts by a combined single-cell analysis from the fly Drosophila melanogaster and the beetle Tribolium castaneum, for which we established a Gal4 enhancer trap system to generate a line marking NBs with tGFP. From the combined dataset of nearly 70,000 neuroblasts, we identified around 23,000 brain neuroblasts, from which we identified cell populations and their transcriptional signatures. We found 188 brain-specific TFs, including seven spatially restricted transcription factors not previously associated with neuroblasts (Hmx, CG15696, CG32532, dmrt99B, fD59A, TfAP-2, and Fer1). In addition to the expected canonical Type II NBs, we found two related clusters with intriguing transcriptional divergence. The large number of brain-specific TFs supports a profound divergence between the insect brain and posterior CNS. Together with recent work in vertebrates, our data confirm an ancient divergence of the brain from the trunk.
papers.translated_summary: 大脑是整合信息以指导动物行为的中央处理中心，而后部中枢神经系统则执行较少中枢性的功能。这种功能区分在基因调控分化中的反映程度尚未被探索，关于大脑与躯干中枢神经系统具有不同进化起源的假说也尚未被研究。在昆虫中，神经母细胞生物学在整个中枢神经系统中是相似的，但脑特异性神经母细胞类型的存在及其空间和时间特化所涉及基因集的差异表明存在分化。然而，一直缺乏对脑与躯干神经母细胞调控密码的全面且无偏见的比较。在此，我们通过结合果蝇Drosophila melanogaster和甲虫Tribolium castaneum的单细胞分析，揭示了昆虫胚胎神经母细胞中表达的转录因子，其中我们建立了一个Gal4增强子陷阱系统来生成标记tGFP神经母细胞的品系。从近70，000个神经母细胞的合并数据集中，我们鉴定出约23，000个脑神经母细胞，从中我们识别了细胞群体及其转录特征。我们发现了188个脑特异性转录因子，包括七个先前未与神经母细胞关联的空间限制性转录因子（Hmx、CG15696、CG32532、dmrt99B、fD59A、TfAP-2和Fer1）。除了预期的经典II型神经母细胞外，我们还发现了两个具有有趣转录分化的相关簇。大量脑特异性转录因子支持昆虫大脑与后部中枢神经系统之间的深刻分化。结合最近在脊椎动物中的工作，我们的数据证实了大脑与躯干之间的古老分化。

papers.title: A bistable type III secretion system is primed and loaded in Pseudomonas aeruginosa hypervirulent isolates with positively selected codon changes in exsA or exsD
papers.translated_title: III型分泌系统呈双稳态，在铜绿假单胞菌高毒力分离株中被启动并装载，这些分离株在exsA或exsD中具有正选择密码子改变
papers.author: Reuven, A.
papers.summary: Pseudomonas aeruginosa has multiple virulence factors that promote airway infections in people with immune deficiencies. Most clinical isolates from human infections have functional type III secretion systems (T3SSs) that are subject to bistable regulation and secrete the cytotoxic effector ExoS into neutrophils. During airway infection in people with cystic fibrosis (CF), P. aeruginosa maintains bistable regulation or genetically adapts by inactivating or hyperactivating T3SS expression. CF clinical isolates with hyperactive T3SSs have codon changes in the transcriptional regulators, exsA or exsD. It is not known how these mutations: 1) arise, 2) promote hypervirulence, or 3) impact bistable T3SS regulation. To understand how these mutants arise, ~24,000 genomes in the NCBI Pathogens database were searched for positively selected mutations in exs genes based on nonsynonomous to synonymous codon change ratios. Missense and nonsense mutations were detected in exsA (47) or exsD (45) the majority of which are predicted to be positively selected. To determine how one of these codon changes promotes hypervirulence, an exsAT48I isolate was used to establish lung infections in mice engineered with a CF genotype. The exsAT48I mutant and an exsA+ control had similar lung burdens, but the former caused exacerbated weight loss and lung inflammation, suggesting immunopathology from phagocyte death as the cause of hypervirulence. Two additional hyperactive mutants were identified by screening a small collection of isolates from children with CF. Immunoblotting and fluorescence microscopy showed that hyperactive exsA or exsD mutants increased production of T3SS injectisomes and effectors, indicating they have locked on (primed and loaded) phenotypes. ExsA dimer modeling revealed that codon changes like T48I in the {beta}-barrel domain cause a conformational change that hyperactivates the transcription factor. These results define that hyperactive mutants are positively selected, hypervirulent due to lung inflammation, and have primed and loaded T3SSs.
papers.translated_summary: 铜绿假单胞菌具有多种毒力因子，可促进免疫缺陷人群的气道感染。来自人类感染的大多数临床分离株具有功能性III型分泌系统（T3SS），该系统受双稳态调控，并将细胞毒性效应蛋白ExoS分泌至中性粒细胞中。在囊性纤维化（CF）患者的气道感染过程中，铜绿假单胞菌维持双稳态调控，或通过失活或过度激活T3SS表达进行遗传适应。具有过度活跃T3SS的CF临床分离株在转录调控因子exsA或exsD中存在密码子改变。目前尚不清楚这些突变如何：1）产生，2）促进高毒力，或3）影响双稳态T3SS调控。为了解这些突变体如何产生，基于非同义与同义密码子改变比值，在NCBI病原体数据库中约24,000个基因组中搜索了exs基因中受正选择的突变。在exsA（47个）或exsD（45个）中检测到错义和无义突变，其中大多数预测受正选择。为确定其中一个密码子改变如何促进高毒力，使用一株exsAT48I分离株在具有CF基因型的小鼠中建立肺部感染。exsAT48I突变体与exsA+对照具有相似的肺部载量，但前者引起加重的体重减轻和肺部炎症，提示吞噬细胞死亡导致的免疫病理是高毒力的原因。通过对来自CF患儿的一小批分离株进行筛选，鉴定出另外两个过度活跃突变体。免疫印迹和荧光显微镜显示，过度活跃的exsA或exsD突变体增加了T3SS注射体（injectisome）和效应蛋白的产生，表明它们具有锁定开启（预启和装载）的表型。ExsA二聚体建模揭示，{beta}-桶状结构域中如T48I的密码子改变引起构象变化，从而过度激活该转录因子。这些结果明确了过度活跃突变体受正选择、因肺部炎症而具有高毒力，并具有预启和装载的T3SS。

papers.title: Ocean depth modifies host-microbiome ecology and evolution
papers.translated_title: 海洋深度改变宿主-微生物组生态与演化
papers.author: Diez-Vives, C.
papers.summary: A major unsolved question in ecology and evolution is how similar free-living and symbiotic microbial communities are. In marine systems, depth homogenises free-living communities due to stronger dispersal and weaker environmental filtering compared to surface waters. We show that symbiotic communities of marine sponges follow a different pattern, with a subset of sponge species mirroring the increased similarity with depth seen in their free-living counterparts, while others remain highly host-specific both in shallow and deep waters. Moreover, in deep waters, more phylogenetically similar hosts harbor more similar microbiomes, yet host-symbiont cophylogeny nearly vanishes. This reveals two contrasting eco-evolutionary assembly rules: in more constant environments like the deep sea, community assembly is driven by host and environmental filtering with minimal signature of coevolution, whereas in variable environments, like shallow waters, host-symbiont coevolution is strong and key to maintain host-specific microbiomes.
papers.translated_summary: 生态学和进化生物学中一个尚未解决的重大问题是，自由生活与共生微生物群落的相似程度如何。在海洋系统中，与表层水体相比，由于更强的扩散作用和更弱的环境过滤，深度使自由生活群落趋于均质化。我们发现，海洋海绵的共生群落遵循一种不同的模式：一部分海绵物种与其自由生活对应物一样，表现出随深度增加相似性升高的趋势，而另一些物种无论在浅水还是深水都保持高度的宿主特异性。此外，在深水中，系统发育上更相似的宿主拥有更相似的微生物组，然而宿主-共生体共系统发育关系几乎消失。这揭示了两种截然不同的生态-进化组装规则：在像深海这样更为恒定的环境中，群落组装由宿主过滤和环境过滤驱动，共进化的印记极小；而在像浅水这样多变的环境中，宿主-共生体共进化作用强烈，是维持宿主特异性微生物组的关键。

papers.title: Optimisation of single-nuclei isolation and RNA sequencing of parasitic nematodes
papers.translated_title: 寄生线虫单核分离及RNA测序的优化
papers.author: Buddenborg, S. K.
papers.summary: Single-cell/nuclei transcriptomics has revolutionised our understanding of cell, tissue, and organismal biology in humans and model organisms across health and disease. However, for non-model species, reassessment and refinement of conventional methods is needed to address novel technical and biological challenges. Here, we evaluate three established nuclei isolation protocols and, building on these experiences, develop an optimised protocol for single-nuclei isolation of parasitic nematodes (SNIP). SNIP recovered 1.7- to 4.1-fold more nuclei than the three established protocols, and 3.2-fold more RNA per nucleus than the best-performing of these. We validated SNIP across macroscopic and microscopic life stages and both sexes of two phylogenetically distinct gastrointestinal nematodes, Haemonchus contortus and Trichuris muris, and used it to generate single-nuclei RNA-seq data revealing sex- and stage-specific gene expression and putative tissue-specific expression in both species. By enabling flexibility with frozen samples and consistent recovery across diverse parasitic nematode life stages, SNIP provides a practical foundation for building cell and nuclei atlases in other non-model species, toward advancing understanding from fundamental biology to infection and disease.
papers.translated_summary: 单细胞/细胞核转录组学已经彻底改变了我们对人类和模式生物在健康与疾病状态下细胞、组织和整体生物学的理解。然而，对于非模式物种，需要重新评估和优化传统方法，以应对新的技术和生物学挑战。在此，我们评估了三种已有的细胞核分离方案，并在此基础上开发了一种针对寄生线虫单细胞核分离的优化方案（SNIP）。SNIP 回收的细胞核数量比三种已有方案多 1.7 至 4.1 倍，每个细胞核的 RNA 回收量比其中表现最佳的方案多 3.2 倍。我们在两种系统发育上不同的胃肠道线虫——捻转血矛线虫（Haemonchus contortus）和鼠鞭虫（Trichuris muris）——的宏观和微观生活史阶段及两种性别中验证了 SNIP，并利用它生成了单细胞核 RNA 测序数据，揭示了两个物种中性别和生活史阶段特异性的基因表达以及推测的组织特异性表达。SNIP 能够灵活处理冷冻样本，并在多种寄生线虫生活史阶段中实现一致的回收效果，为在其他非模式物种中构建细胞和细胞核图谱提供了实用基础，有助于推动从基础生物学到感染与疾病的理解。

papers.title: Horizontal transfer of an antimicrobial peptide across insects
papers.translated_title: 抗菌肽在昆虫间的水平转移
papers.author: Aumont, C.
papers.summary: Antimicrobial peptides (AMPs) are key defence molecules of the innate immune system. Understanding the origins of AMPs can help to explain how immune systems acquire novelty and vary in their defence capacities. However, AMPs evolve rapidly, and so the origins of similar AMPs across organisms is often unclear. Furthermore, false negatives due to low search sensitivity are common and can hinder confident annotations about true absences. As a result, understanding whether similar AMP genes found in diverse organisms represent ancestral molecules or evolutionary novelties has been challenging. Here, we present evidence of horizontal gene transfer (HGT) of the antifungal peptide gene Drosomycin across insects. We show that in Diptera, the presence of Drosomycin is restricted to the Drosophila Melanogaster species group and additionally the distant relative Drosophila busckii. We go on to recover Drosomycin genes in cockroaches (Blattodea), mantises (Mantodea), katydids (Orthoptera), beetles (Coleoptera), parasitic wasps (Hymenoptera), and a recently acquired and pseudogenized Drosomycin locus in Liposcelis booklice (Psocodea), but not other insects. Explaining this diversity through shared ancestry requires at least 60 independent loss events, or just nine HGT events. Previous studies have suggested that similar AMPs found across divergent species reflect conservation from a common ancestor, or due to their small size, that they arose via convergent evolution. Our findings suggest horizontal gene transfer can be responsible for the presence of some AMP genes scattered across the tree of life. By presenting a mechanism through which immune systems can acquire novelty, our study also suggests a possible explanation for certain lineage-specific defence competencies against infectious disease. While loss of AMP genes is well-documented, here we suggest gain of AMPs can occur just as suddenly.
papers.translated_summary: 抗菌肽（AMPs）是先天免疫系统的关键防御分子。理解抗菌肽的起源有助于解释免疫系统如何获得新特性以及其防御能力为何存在差异。然而，抗菌肽进化迅速，因此不同生物中相似抗菌肽的起源往往不明确。此外，由于搜索灵敏度低而导致的假阴性很常见，这可能妨碍对真正缺失的可靠注释。因此，理解不同生物中发现的相似抗菌肽基因究竟代表祖先分子还是进化新特性一直具有挑战性。在此，我们提供了抗真菌肽基因Drosomycin在昆虫间发生水平基因转移（HGT）的证据。我们表明，在双翅目中，Drosomycin的存在仅限于黑腹果蝇种组以及另外的近缘种Drosophila busckii。我们进一步在蟑螂（蜚蠊目）、螳螂（螳螂目）、螽斯（直翅目）、甲虫（鞘翅目）、寄生蜂（膜翅目）中发现了Drosomycin基因，并在Liposcelis书虱（啮虫目）中发现了一个近期获得且已假基因化的Drosomycin位点，但在其他昆虫中未发现。通过共同祖先来解释这种多样性至少需要60次独立丢失事件，或者仅需九次水平基因转移事件。此前的研究曾提出，在不同物种中发现的相似抗菌肽反映了来自共同祖先的保守性，或者由于其体积小，是通过趋同进化产生的。我们的发现表明，水平基因转移可能是某些抗菌肽基因散布于生命树中的原因。通过提出一种免疫系统可以获得新特性的机制，我们的研究还为某些谱系对传染病的特异性防御能力提供了一种可能的解释。虽然抗菌肽基因的丢失已有充分文献记载，但我们在此提出抗菌肽的获得同样可以突然发生。

papers.title: Genetic control and tissue specificity of transcriptomic rhythmicity
papers.translated_title: 转录组节律性的遗传控制与组织特异性
papers.author: Chauquet, S.
papers.summary: Circadian rhythms influence molecular traits in most tissues, yet genetic studies mostly treat molecular measurements as static. In particular, genetic effects on gene expression are typically investigated through expression quantitative trait locus (eQTL) studies, which ignore sampling time and therefore miss genetic effects on rhythm parameters such as amplitude and acrophase. In this study, we used a cosinor-based joint genotype-by-rhythm interaction framework applied to GTEx version 10 gene expression data, with donor inferred phase as a proxy for circadian time. We first identified rhythmically expressed genes in 49 of the 50 tissues profiled in GTEx. We then tested common variants within 50 kb of each rhythmic gene's transcription start site for genetic regulation of transcriptomic rhythmicity. We identified 167 circadian expression QTLs (cd-eQTLs), comprising 54 lead signals for 51 genes across 28 tissues. Most cd-eQTLs altered oscillation amplitude, while others affected acrophase or both. We then investigated the tissue specificity of cd-eQTLs and found that those acting on core circadian genes had consistent effects across tissues, whereas those acting on clock-regulated genes were largely tissue-specific. A phenome-wide association study in the Pan-UK Biobank linked 34 cd-eQTLs to 100 phenotypes, including self-reported chronotype, adiposity, blood cell counts and blood biochemistry. These results show that genetic variation shapes circadian gene expression in a tissue-dependent manner, and that accounting for time of day reveals regulatory effects that static eQTL analyses cannot detect.
papers.translated_summary: 昼夜节律影响大多数组织中的分子特征，然而遗传学研究大多将分子测量视为静态。特别是，基因表达的遗传效应通常通过表达数量性状位点（eQTL）研究来探究，这些研究忽略了采样时间，因而错过了对振幅和峰值相位等节律参数的遗传效应。在本研究中，我们采用基于余弦分析的基因型-节律交互联合框架，应用于GTEx第10版基因表达数据，以推断的供体相位作为昼夜节律时间的代理。我们首先在GTEx所分析的50个组织中的49个中鉴定了节律性表达基因。随后，我们在每个节律性基因转录起始位点50 kb范围内的常见变异中检测了转录组节律性的遗传调控。我们鉴定了167个昼夜节律表达QTL（cd-eQTL），包括28个组织中51个基因的54个先导信号。大多数cd-eQTL改变了振荡振幅，而其他则影响峰值相位或两者兼有。接着我们研究了cd-eQTL的组织特异性，发现作用于核心昼夜节律基因的cd-eQTL在各组织中具有一致效应，而作用于时钟调控基因的cd-eQTL则大多具有组织特异性。在Pan-UK Biobank中进行的全表型组关联研究将34个cd-eQTL与100个表型相关联，包括自我报告的时型、肥胖度、血细胞计数和血液生化指标。这些结果表明，遗传变异以组织依赖的方式塑造昼夜节律基因表达，且考虑一天中的时间可揭示静态eQTL分析无法检测到的调控效应。
